depth.task: Design: the typed-pipeline wiring plan — where typed labels enter assembly, how gates receive the typed packet, what the expected hold set is for examples/culture-d2 (name each expected hold); reports/round-11/depth/design.md.

Implementation shards (single integrator owns the touched files; others deliver code fragments): assembler consumption of typed labels; gate reader adapter; holds mapping (TL-01 -> named holds); projection validator; CLI entry; frozen re-pin mechanics.

Test shards: e2e positive over examples/culture-d2; findings == expected hold set exactly; legacy-vs-typed differential (translated labels off the sound channel); determinism; replay-frozen; boundary/malformed; CLI negatives; interop with d3 path; battery green.
Three negative examples targeting the wiring (a translated label smuggled onto the sound channel; an owed form dropped silently; a hold laundered as clean) — each must be caught.
Adversarial reviewers: wiring vs design spec; hold-set completeness; circularity (a re-pin blessing its own change).
Scribes: capability-row draft; frozen-manifest records; fragment ledger.

operability.task: Design the handoff-e2e exercise: field map from live D2/D3 artifacts to the 16-field envelope; reports/round-11/handoff/design.md.
Implementation: tools/exercise-handoff-e2e.py with --selftest (positive + malformed controls); single writer.
Packet assembly from live artifacts (4 shard attempts, best integrated): 16/16 fields, 20/20 glossary entries populated from actual D2/D3 content.
Gate runs: handoff-packet-check over the assembled packet in an isolated copy; record verdicts; contract cross-reference verification (worldbible-integration-contract.md fields).
Frozen expected.json baseline for the exercise + tamper control.
Adversarial reviewers: envelope completeness; any field populated with placeholder rather than live content.

freshness.task: Eight recheck rerunners: take ledger rows by index (rows[i] for i in your assigned slice of the 192-row reports/round-10/drift/ledger.json), re-run each command 1:1 (export TMPDIR=$PWD/.scratch), compare output_sha256; receipt per row reports/round-11/recheck/row-<NNN>.json {stable: bool, prior_hash, new_hash, drift_cause?}.
Drift disposition: for every unstable row, name the cause (legitimate change / environmental / defect) with evidence.
Recheck auditor: independently re-run >=5 rechecked commands; mismatch with the recheck receipts = finding; reports/round-11/recheck/audit.md.
Recheck scribe: summary JSON {rows_reckecked, stable, unstable, dispositions}; reports/round-11/recheck/summary.json.

scribe_review: X01 lessons gate-keeper; X02 adjacency/connector + out-of-lane watch; X03 run-validation.py author; X04 report scribe.
